heading.emphasisDevice: weight/color shift on one phrase; soft pill eyebrow chips label each section

composition.hero: text block left ~45%; large lg-radius image right; floating avatar cluster bottom-left of image; small circular camera chip top-right; mixed-weight headline emphasising one phrase
composition.reviews: masonry of short quote cards + one single-featured testimonial with full-bleed image

imagery.grading: warm, natural light, slightly muted greens; no clinical white-balance
imagery.framing: one hero subject offset in-frame; supporting imagery environmental and candid
imagery.subjectTreatment: warm candid portraits of subjects mid-care; never posed-clinical; human (or pet) gaze toward camera in hero only

package selector renders as tabs, not a 3-card grid
card radius reads as lg, surfaces are tonal on a warm ground
section eyebrows are soft tonal pill chips (the reference's deliberate device), not bare uppercase text
